summary: Meeting Father Thomas in an abandoned wing of the manor before dawn, Catherine orchestrates a calculated conspiracy to stall the council hearing and extract inside intelligence, sealing their treasonous alliance with intimate assurance.
key_events: Confrontation between CATHERINE and others: You took your time.

secrets_or_revelations: CATHERINE: 'You didn't need them the first time, either. I just prefer my secrets thorough.'
CATHERINE: 'It will keep serving us as long as neither of us gets careless. No one in this house so much as suspects your face belongs to that morning. Let's keep it that way.'
CATHERINE: 'Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her.'
